subject: Entity Disambiguation
source_sentence: Entity disambiguation (ED) refers to the task of assigning mentions in a document to correspond- ing entities in a knowledge base (KB). This task is challenging because of the ambiguity between men- tions (e.g., "World Cup") and the entities they refer to (e.g., FIFA World Cup or Rugby World Cup).
